title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.

translated_title: 运行一次，得到两个：本地LLM的近乎零成本的流式安全检查
translated_abstract: 本地LLM助手一次只为一个用户解码，因此解码受内存带宽限制，计算资源处于闲置状态。如今的流式安全检查需要在准确性与成本之间权衡：专用的防护模型虽然准确，但几乎使每个token的延迟翻倍；而基于隐藏状态的探针虽然廉价，但准确性较低。我们提出ToRA，这是一种适配器，它在生成器的解码步骤中将第二个模型作为额外的一行来运行，共享其权重和KV缓存。双行内核只需为两行各读取一次每个权重。在Qwen3-0.6B上，ToRA匹配或超越了专用的流式防护模型，在17个基准测试中的12个上取得了更高的F1分数。它在相似成本下比探针多检测出11.8个百分点的不安全响应，且每个token仅增加不到4%的延迟。
tldr: ToRA通过让第二个模型作为额外一行嵌入生成器的解码步骤并共享权重与KV缓存，以每个token不到4%的额外延迟实现了接近专用防护模型准确性的本地LLM流式安全检查。
en_tdlr: ToRA runs a second model as an extra row within the generator's decode step, sharing weights and KV cache, achieving dedicated-guard-level streaming safety checks for local LLMs at under 4% added latency per token.
